text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Will they discover the legendary cat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
伝説の猫、
発見なるか！？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that the mysterious feline Bigcat has been sighted,
the Tamaki Expedition Team flies straight into the heart
of the jungle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ見ぬ秘境に未確認猫、
「ビッグキャット」の目撃情報を聞いたタマキ探検隊は、
一路
ジャングルの奥地へと飛んだ！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There they encounter rocks! Cliffs! And cat repellent!
Will the team be able to survive this ordeal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ち受ける岩！　
崖！　
そして猫よけビン！
果たして、
一行は無事に帰ってこられるのか！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up with you, {0}? 
You look down right purr-plexed by the narration.
choice_data_list: For starters, we're not in the jungle.
When did you form an expedition team?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、{0}、
なんなのにゃ？
今のナレーションに無限にツッコミたいみたいな顔してるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Don't sweat the details, {0}.
Fur-get about all that and just enjoy the adventure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむっ、
{0}は、細かいことを気にするにゃあ。
こういうのは、
楽しんだ人が勝ちなのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyo point in being so purr-fectly sensible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
凝り固まった考えは、
いけないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow that was today, of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはもちろん、
今日にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I called you out here so you can help me out
with the expedition!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそも{0}は、
探検隊に勧誘するために声をかけたのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, Bigcat is said to be two meters tall,
weighs 500 kilograms, and walks on its hind legs.
There's nyo telling what'll happen, so stick close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより
「ビッグキャット」は身長２メートル、
体重500キロ、
二足歩行で歩くと言われているにゃ。
何があるかわからないからしっかりついてくるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Cats
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, if any of you see anything suspicious,
tell me as soon as paw—
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
何か不審なものを見つけたら、
すぐに教える──

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on!
text_block_list.orig_text: ってあれは……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Meowzer, that massive boulder is headed straight fur us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変にゃ、
目の前に大岩が転がってくるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Eek!
{0}, watch out! *hug*
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃー！
{0}、危ないにゃー！　
ひしっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Whew... Nyow that was dangerous.
choice_data_list: Wasn't that boulder... made out of Styrofoam?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
危ないところだったにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's that?
Nyo idea what you're talking about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんのことかにゃ？
あたし、知らないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I-it's nyot like I instructed the cats to roll it or anything.
Absolutely nyot a setup.
text_block_list.orig_text:
べ、
別に猫に指示して転がさせたりなんてしてないにゃ。
きっとやらせなんかじゃないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
C-come on!
Let's keep moving fur-ward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
さあ！
早く奥に進むのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the Tamaki Expedition Team
advances deeper into the heart of the jungle,
fighting for survival every step of the way.
choice_data_list: Seriously, what's up with the narration?
text_block_list.orig_text:
かくして
生命の危険と戦いながら、
タマキ探検隊はジャングルの奥地へと進んだ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Narration is a purr-fectly normal part of any adventure!
Just fur-get about it. Let's keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
探検隊に、
ナレーションはつきものにゃ！
そんなことより、
先に進むのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Meowzers!
Nyow just look at that pawprint!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃーーーーっ！
この足跡を見るにゃーー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: That paw is over one meter in length fur sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この足跡、
軽く見ても１メートル以上はあるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
An im-paw-sible size for any regular cat...
This is purr-suasive proof that Bigcat exists!
choice_data_list: Those cats over there are making the footprints.
text_block_list.orig_text:
通常の猫ではありえない足跡……
これこそ、
ビッグキャットが存在する確実な証拠にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! What are you furballs doing!
You were supposed to finish all of it by today!
That's coming out of your salary of catnip!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
こら、
何をしてるにゃ！
今日までにちゃんと仕事を終わらせておくように言ったにゃ！
それじゃバイト代のまたたびはあげないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Cats
text_block_list.text: Meow, meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃ、にゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hey, get back here nyow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
こら逃げるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Mer... meowr?
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃ……にゃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyoooooo! Gonzales!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃーーーっ！　
ゴンザレス！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Gonzales, charge commander of the expedition,
was so fur-rightened by the cat repellent
that his paw stepped over the ledge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
探検隊切り込み隊長のゴンザレスが、
猫よけビンを恐れるあまり、
崖に半分だけ足を踏み外してしまったにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow! Gonzales! Grab onto this mackerel!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃっ！　
ゴンザレス！　
このかつおぶしに捕まるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Gonzales
text_block_list.text: Meow...
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
He's not even trying to climb back up...?
What're you talking about!
Can't you see the des-purr-ation in his eyes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
真剣に上がる気がなさそうって……
何を言ってるにゃ！
このゴンザレスの必死な目を見るにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Gonzales
text_block_list.text: Meow...
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
\"I can't feel my paws... Farewell, Tamaki...\" Nyo!
Gonzales, life's too purr-ecious to waste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼく、
もう限界……
バイバイ、
タマキちゃん……
にゃって！？
ゴンザレス、
諦めたらダメにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh!
Gonzaleeeeees!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああーーーっ！
ゴンザレスーーーーーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus, Gonzales descends to the bottom of the cliff...
The Tamaki Expedition Team members choke back their tears and march onward!
choice_data_list: The \"cliff\" is only about 30 centimeters tall...
text_block_list.orig_text:
かくして、
ゴンザレスは崖の下へと消えていった……
タマキ探検隊は涙をこらえて、
さらに先へと進む！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Gonzales...
Your sacrifice will nyot be fur-gotten!
choice_data_list: He's playing dead right next to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴンザレス……！
お前の犠牲は
無駄にはしないにゃーー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Gonzales... To honor your memory,
we will purr-ess on 'til we find Bigcat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴンザレス……
お前のためにも、
必ずビッグキャットは見つけてみせるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the mysterious cat creature they had long sought
reveals itself for the entire Tamaki Expedition Team to behold!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、
タマキ探検隊の眼前に、
ついに
待望の未確認猫生物が現れた！！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Up ahead!
By my paws! It's Bigcat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーーーーっ！　
前方注目にゃ！
いたにゃ！　
ビッグキャットにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Gathered Cats
text_block_list.text: Meowwr...
choice_data_list: It's just the cats huddled together and covered in a cloth.
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃおー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: ...Whew.

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Okay, nyow that's a wrap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
バイト終了にゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Fur-ends of the expedition, form a line and greet {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
探検隊のみんなも、整列して{0}に
挨拶するにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Meow! In other words, all of that was just a purr-ank.
Did I cat-cha by surprise?
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃーん。
ということで、
ドッキリだったにゃ。
びっくりしたかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahah... Guess you could tell I was kitten around.
Oh well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはは、
やっぱりびっくりはさせられなかったかにゃ。
残念にゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What?
Why did I go to all the trouble?
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃ？
なんでこんなことをしたかって？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Because I wanted to bring you to this meow-ntain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}を、
ここに連れてくるためにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This is where we fur-st met.
Do you remember?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここ、
あたしたちが初めて出会った場所なのにゃ。
覚えてるかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
When I got to thinking about how everything started fur us,
I felt the urge to bring you back here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだかんだで、
ここから色々始まったんだなあって思ったら、
どうしても{0}をここに連れてきたくなったのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You know...
I'm a bit of a scaredy-cat with the sentimental stuff, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……その、
普段あんまり素直になることはないから……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: {0}... thank you fur everything.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}……いつもありがとうにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahaha! Yup, nyow I've gone and embarrassed myself.
I guess we can call it a day, and—
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはは、
改まっていうのは、
やっぱり恥ずかしいにゃ。
今日のところはもう戻って──

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myah! I've just spotted Bigcat over there!
We must go and purr-sue it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ！　
あそこにビッグキャットが見えたにゃ！
今から、追いかけにいくにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You didn't think it existed? Of course it does!
Why would I lie about something so important nyow?
text_block_list.orig_text:
実在したのかって、
当然にゃ！
こんな大切なことを伝えるのに、
嘘なんてつかないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Come on, {0}!
Let's go cat-ch Bigcat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ{0}！
ビッグキャットを捕まえに行くにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Thus, today marked another day where {0}
was swept up by the fancies of the whimsical Tamaki.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気まぐれなタマキに、
今日も{0}は振り回されるのだった。
